description.value: The Seabreeze is a custom-built craftsman-style guest house in Richmond, BC, perched on a quiet cul-de-sac overlooking the Pacific Ocean and Gulf Islands. It offers three rooms with private en-suite bathrooms, jacuzzi soaker tubs, and ocean-view balconies, with a continental breakfast included in the rates. The property sits directly alongside the Richmond Dyke trails, with historic Steveston Village a short distance away.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and shows 2024 seasonal rates, confirming the business appears operational. No mention of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site; the property is notable for its location beside the Richmond Dyke trails but is positioned as a luxury B&B. A phone number discrepancy exists: OSM and the front-page footer show 778-686-1248, while the rates and reservations subpages both list 778-858-1327 as the primary contact number, indicating one is outdated.
concerns: Phone number inconsistency: OSM and the front-page footer list 778-686-1248, but the rates and reservations subpages list 778-858-1327 as the primary contact — one is likely outdated.
Rates page shows '2024 Rates' only; no 2025 or 2026 pricing listed, suggesting the website may not have been updated recently.
No bike storage or any cyclist-specific amenities mentioned anywhere on the website.
House number 3111 is not explicitly confirmed on the website; directions reference Springside Place but not the street number.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate guest house directly adjacent to the Richmond Dyke cycling trails, making it a plausible touring stop, but no cyclist-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, wash) are mentioned anywhere on the site, and a phone number discrepancy needs resolving before listing.
